# LeadBoxer

Lead generation platform that gives you real-time info about companies and people that visit your website. Turning anonymous web traffic into actionable data.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/leadboxer/.

## Actions

- **Add or Update Lead Tags**: Add or update lead tags in LeadBoxer.
- **Get Events** (read-only): Fetch events for specified sessions from LeadBoxer.
- **Get Lead Detail** (read-only): Fetch detailed information about a lead based on filters.
- **Get Sessions** (read-only): Fetch sessions for a specified lead ID from LeadBoxer.
- **Log Server-Side Event**: Track server-side events in LeadBoxer.
- **Post Event Data**: Send event data for tracking user activities via POST request.
- **Delete Custom Tracking Domain**: Delete a custom tracking domain entry for a dataset.
- **Get Custom Tracking Domains** (read-only): Fetch custom tracking domain entries for a dataset.
- **Get Lead Score Formula** (read-only): Fetch the lead score formula for a specific dataset.
